parsed.internal_thinking: Shon is offering me 1 Wheat for 1 Brick. Looking at my current resources, I have 1 Brick, 1 Wood, 2 Wheat, and 3 Sheep. A settlement costs 1 Brick, 1 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I already have exactly what I need to build a settlement at Node 14 on my next turn (I have a road leading there). Trading away my only Brick would prevent me from building and give Shon a resource he needs to expand. Given our history (he betrayed me last game) and the fact that this trade actively hurts my immediate progress, I must reject it.
parsed.note_to_self: I have the resources for a settlement at Node 14. Do not trade away the Brick or Wood. Shon is trying to get resources for his own expansion.
parsed.say_outloud: שון, אני ממש צריכה את הלבנה הזאת לבנייה הבאה שלי, אז אני לא יכולה לוותר עליה כרגע. אולי בהמשך אם המצב ישתנה.
